title: FCT12 fact-unit delivery: frozen A12/T12 comparison criteria
authorship: Factual/source audit worker in the same parent context; not a blind or independent-model review.
supplement_role: Extends delivery-stage bookkeeping for FCT12; does not modify any old question, evidence requirement, grade, scope choice, denominator, or semantic acceptance criterion.

authority.precedence: Unchanged evaluation_contract.json governs required facts, HOLD/refusal treatment and semantic admissions. This supplement adds explicit three-stage validation/delivery/completion accounting and pairedT12 retention.

arms.A12: Previously saved baseline packet: original candidate union, ranks, scores, selected12, actual delivered document membership/order and text.
arms.T12: Previously executed whole physical-table attachment arm, immutable reference; old packet/receipt used as is.
arms.FCT12: New source-verified fact-unit projection over the same selected physical tables, original packet retained. No search or answer call.

fixed_invariants.actual_delivered_document_membership: Exactly saved A12; actual delivered count may be below12 due to earlier packet cap. Never restore omitted source documents by new UID injection.
fixed_invariants.original_fields: All existing text/context/document_id/source_id/chunk_id strings and document order byte-identical. Added fields may only carry validated fact units.
fixed_invariants.fact_order: Physical source row/column order under fixed selected-document order; no question, gold value, benchmark ID, evaluator unit or prior result used for selection, priority or budget reservation.
fixed_invariants.source_gate: Facts and dependencies must map to saved structure and unchanged source. A failed aggregate row may be rejected independently only under the generic declared unit validator; no case-specific exception.
fixed_invariants.budget_gate: Count the actual serialized final packet bytes; no truncating original source, silent row/header clipping, reordering, or output-size tuning after results.
fixed_invariants.immutability: All prior artifacts, runtime code, .env and v12 store remain unchanged. No model/provider/retrieval/answer calls.

hypothesis_and_falsification.primary_hypothesis: A valid fact unit can survive unrelated whole-table structural failure while retaining enough literal axes to be useful in the final fixed-budget packet.
hypothesis_and_falsification.positive_signal: At least one predeclared missing required fact or mandatory axis is actually serialized with verified source relations, while prior required evidence remains present and no attachment introduces false binding.
falsification_or_null: Validated facts remain outside the packet because physical order or byte cap excludes them.
Projection adds only duplicates of already present facts or richer context without closing a predeclared gap.
Valid investment facts lack additional required profit-summary evidence.
The smaller granularity drops mandatory row/column/period/unit/entity dependencies, creates false relations or loses a T12 recovered axis.
hypothesis_and_falsification.interpretation: A null or mixed outcome ends this frozen comparison; do not add retries, tune selection or weaken validation to obtain a recovery.

three_stage_unit_status.separation_rule: Source validation pass is never delivery pass; delivery pass is never full question completion. Record all three independently with original locators, serialized packet positions and rejection reasons.

required_review_record_fields: literal row and column header paths
literal period and any explicitcalendar mapping
subject and consolidation scope supported by source
FCT12 actual delivery outcome and packet location
FCT12 mandatory axes complete or unresolved
new value versus new axis versus duplication

paired_scoring.A12_to_FCT12: Use unchanged original requirements. New fact/axis recovery only if missing in actual A12 and actually delivered/source-supported in FCT12.
paired_scoring.T12_to_FCT12: Check retention as well as gains. A fact/mandatoryaxis appended in T12 but absent in FCT12 is a delivery regression relative to T12, even though A12 original strings are preserved.
paired_scoring.numeric_values: Do not count repeated amount, a source UID, scalar hint or metadata-only value as new recovery. Alternative UIDs are allowed only through source-equivalent facts.
paired_scoring.unit_retention: A caption copied elsewhere in packet does not preserve a unit unless it is traceably linked to the retained amount columns.
paired_scoring.dependency_closure: For each transmitted fact, check the row subject, all required stacked headers, scope/period/unit captions and explicit signs/qualifiers. A valid bare value with missing dependencies is incomplete evidence, not complete fact recovery.
paired_scoring.cell_vs_row_count: Internal cell counts do not change frozen evaluator-unit denominator. Splitting one required relation into several fact units cannot inflate recoveries.
paired_scoring.relative_period: Literal 당기/전기/제N기 axes are retained evidence. A missing absolute calendar mapping is not parserloss and is not silently supplied from reportyear.
paired_scoring.prose: Policy/causal/strategy and temporal-limit prose remains mandatory where frozen contract requires it. Tablecell delivery is not a substitute.
paired_scoring.raw_and_semantic: Original string equality proves deterministic nonloss only. No inference about model reading, answer accuracy/completeness/faithfulness or refusal performance.

three_independent_gates: SOURCE_VALIDATION: Does the fact unit uniquely map its value, row/column headers and literal context to the original source? A different row failing cannot be silently used as proof this row passed.

DELIVERY: Does the actual final FCT12 packet contain that validated unit and required axes under the unchanged65536UTF8byte cap and fixed physical ordering? Receipt-only survival or a hypothetical smaller representation does not count.

REQUIREMENT_COMPLETION: Does the delivered source relation satisfy unchanged ownership/carrying/profit-summary requirements? A valid investment row or one profit cell does not imply the whole case complete.
required_distinctions: Closing ownership25.81% and carrying1,294,367백만원 are the labelled separate/investment-table alternative; preserve source scope and distinguish acquisition2020.03.01 from ending2023.12.31.

The investment table includes latest-business-year netprofit−803,742; label exactly that row/column relation. It does not by itself supply the frozen four-cell connected profit summary with named revenue1,775,continuingprofit−803,742,OCI12,115,totalcomprehensive−791,627백만원.
If ownership and carrying are actually delivered and supported but required profit summary remains absent, judge PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_RECOVERY; no full recovery.
A valid row still excluded by fixed ordering/budget is VALID_BUT_NOT_DELIVERED and NO_RECOVERY for its required fact.
Do not relax the criterion after seeing output, move this row earlier, reserve budget for it, replace earlier units, or query/answer-select it.
Do not infer from prior failure that repairing validation would fit budget; actual serialization decides.
